_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 73 windows producing a ±2+ score move, HOLD is the statistically honest call — the coil has not broken and no breaker signal has fired; naming UP here without fed_liquidity confirmation would repeat the 0-for-18 forced-guess pattern.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst leans UP toward Hope on historical analog progression; narrative headlines fading momentum, creating a split on whether the next leg is resolution or continued drift
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity ticks above 10 AND btc_momentum_30d sustains above 55 with funding remaining below 0.015%
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 100.5 AND btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 70
